\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xbar,bar width=9pt,width=10cm,height=6.5cm,
  xmin=-2,xmax=6,ymin=.4,ymax=3.6,enlargelimits=false,ytick={1,2,3},
  xmajorgrids,legend pos=south east]
  \addplot[red,draw=blue,fill,line width=1pt,opacity=.6,fill opacity=.24]
    coordinates {(-1,1) (2,2) (4,3)};
  \addplot[draw=purple,fill=none,line join=round,line width=1.5pt,
    dash pattern=on 3pt off 2pt,draw opacity=.2,opacity=.8]
    coordinates {(3,1) (4,2) (5,3)};
  \legend{Two colors,Outline}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
